meaning: Side-information channel capacity and ambiguity-reduction bit-budget codebase benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 132): Phase 1 separates zero-bit constant encoder and sub-Nyquist capacity deficit (`encoder_bits = 0, bit_budget_b = 1, S = 2 < K = 4, realized_subfiber_error_floor = 3, capacity_error_floor_k_minus_s = 2, surcharge = 10, payout = 863 != 873, Delta_E = -1`); Phase 2 separates partial encoder upgrade under sub-Nyquist 1-bit channel ceiling (`encoder_bits = 1, bit_budget_b = 1, S_used = S = 2 < K = 4, realized_subfiber_error_floor = 2, capacity_error_floor_k_minus_s = 2, surcharge = 8, payout = 865 != 873, Delta_E = -1`); Phase 3 verifies full Nyquist side-information capacity provisioning (`encoder_bits = 2, bit_budget_b = 2, S_used = S = 4 = K, realized_subfiber_error_floor = 0, capacity_error_floor_k_minus_s = 0, surcharge = 0, 873 + 27 + 90 = 990, Delta_E = 0`).
